name: Morning Market Breakfast
effect: Line up 3 daytime FOOD vendors before dusk (drinks don't count). You've booked the dawn-market run — the island's market arcades at sunrise, soy milk and egg crepe and hot congee — and you want the busload seated before the stalls pack up.
art_note: Boarding-pass ticket: sunrise over a market arcade, three little breakfast bowls stamped in a row.

name: Beat the Crowds
effect: Win 3 vendors BEFORE dusk. You've booked the sunrise slot at the island's queue-famous stalls — in and seated before the lines snake round the block.
art_note: Ticket: a wide-awake owl over a sunrise market, a short queue just starting to form.

name: Check-in Trail
effect: Your won daytime tables cost 7+ ingredients in total — the big daytime check-in (打卡) spots worth queueing for. Booked as a photo-op tour; judged at dusk.
art_note: Ticket: a phone framing a bowl over a rising daytime crowd.

name: Dragon-Boat Food Run
effect: Line up 3 FOOD vendors before dusk (drinks don't count). You've booked the Dragon-Boat riverside outing — zongzi unwrapped by the water, drums pounding as the boats race off the wharf. Land all three before the day runs out.
art_note: Ticket: a dragon-boat prow on a river, three festival food parcels along the bank.

name: Coin-Snack Tour
effect: Win 3 vendors each costing 2 ingredients or fewer, before dusk. You've booked the beloved coin-snack (銅板美食) crawl — big flavour, small change, stall to stall across the island's markets. A day-locked gamble.
art_note: Ticket: three little coins beside a paper snack tray and a receipt.

name: Out-Hype the Rival
effect: Win 1 CONTESTED vendor before dusk (a rival had Followers on it when you won). You booked the busload onto the island's most-hyped stall — and SNATCHED it out from under a rival mid-pitch. With daylight to spare.
art_note: Ticket: two hands reaching for one glowing stall.

name: Mid-Autumn BBQ
effect: Win 3 night-market FOOD vendors. You've booked the Mid-Autumn grill run — the whole island out on the pavement firing up the BBQ, mooncakes stacked, a pomelo rind on some kid's head. Three stalls, go.
art_note: Ticket: a night grill glowing under a full moon, a pomelo beside it.

name: Neon Bites
effect: Win 2 night-market FOOD vendors. You've booked two stalls in one blazing neon lane of the island's night markets — snag them before a rival's crowd fills the aisle.
art_note: Ticket: two glowing night stalls in one neon night-market lane.

name: Chasing a Star
effect: Win a ★ apex vendor — a region's top table, a Michelin / 必比登 name. You've booked the busload a marquee seat, and you are chasing that star.
art_note: Ticket: a hand plucking a gold star from a marquee sign.

name: Marquee Splurge
effect: Win a vendor costing 4+ ingredients. You booked the splashy stop — a marquee 名店, the big name worth every ingredient of it.
art_note: Ticket: a fat wallet snapping open over a feast.

name: Two-Marquee Feast
effect: Win 2 vendors each costing 4+ ingredients. You booked a big-name double bill — two marquee 名店 on one itinerary.
art_note: Ticket: two heavy coin purses on a night stall.

name: Border Dish
effect: Win 1 cross-region (→X) dish — a recipe that packed its bags, rode the line across a regional border, and landed on your tour's plate.
art_note: Ticket: a dish straddling two region stamps.

name: Two Borders
effect: Win 2 cross-region (→X) dishes — two recipes that each hopped a regional border to reach your itinerary.
art_note: Ticket: two dishes each straddling two regions.

name: Closing-Time Sprint
effect: Win 2 vendors in the FINAL round. You booked the closing-time sprint — shutters rolling down, the last train already up on the departures board. Two more before it pulls out.
art_note: Ticket: a departures board flipping to LAST TRAIN.

name: Full-Day Itinerary
effect: Win 4 vendors in total. You booked a packed one-day itinerary (一日遊) — a proper island day-trip, four stops before the last train. Finish any time.
art_note: Ticket: four little stall stamps laid out on a day-planner grid.

name: Budget Bites
effect: Win 2 vendors each costing 2 ingredients or fewer. You booked a small-wallet, big-appetite crawl of the island's cheap-eats lanes. Finish any time.
art_note: Ticket: two coins and a small snack in a paper sleeve.

name: Taroko Day Trip
effect: Win 1 East vendor. You've booked the run out east — Taroko's marble gorge and the Pacific coast road. Finish any time.
art_note: Ticket stamped EAST: Taroko gorge cliffs over a rice-terrace coastline.

name: Become a Regular
effect: Win 2 vendors in ONE region (any region). You booked the same town twice — settle onto one old street till the stallholders know your bus by sight. Finish any time.
art_note: Ticket: two stamps stacked under one region badge.

name: Taipei–Taichung Line
effect: Win 1 North vendor AND 1 Central vendor. You booked the HSR from under Taipei 101 down to Taichung — a pork bun in the capital, a cup of tea in the belt. Finish any time.
art_note: Ticket: a pork bun under a Taipei 101 silhouette and a tea leaf over Taichung, an HSR line running between them.

name: South-Link Coast Run
effect: Win 1 South vendor AND 1 East vendor. You booked the South-Link (南迴) rail around the cape — Kenting prawns of the coast, Taitung rice of the hills. Finish any time.
art_note: Ticket: a prawn and a rice ear stamped together over a winding coast road.

name: A Bite & a Sip
effect: Win 1 food vendor AND 1 drink. The simplest package on the island — one thing to chew, one thing to sip, the golden rule of every night market. Finish any time.
art_note: Ticket: a bowl and a cup side by side.

name: The Breakfast Set
effect: Win 1 daytime food AND 1 drink. You booked the classic morning-market set — a bite and a cup. Finish any time.
art_note: Ticket: a breakfast bowl and a morning cup.

name: Hand-Shaken Trail
effect: Win 2 drink vendors. You booked the hand-shaken (手搖) tea trail every island afternoon deserves — sip your way stand to stand, any time.
art_note: Ticket: two sweating cups of iced hand-shaken tea.

name: Dihua Street Food Crawl
effect: Win 1 Dadaocheng (Dihua Street 迪化街) vendor — the dawn egg-crepe stall or a riverside neon cup — AND 1 night-market food. Booked to open on the old street at dawn and close under the neon.
art_note: Ticket: the red-brick Dihua shophouse arcade of 大稻埕 with a griddled egg crepe and a riverside neon tea cup stamped together.

name: Tainan Old-Capital Crawl
effect: Win 2 Tainan (府城) vendors — milkfish congee and rice-bowl cake by day, coffin bread and shrimp noodles by night. The old capital by the Anping fort, booked stop by stop.
art_note: Ticket stamped 府城: an Anping fort silhouette over a Tainan oyster-flat motif, two stall stamps.

name: Taichung City Crawl
effect: Win 2 Taichung vendors — birthplace of bubble tea, the markets around the old station clock-tower. A city crawl booked for any time of day.
art_note: Ticket stamped 臺中: a station clock-tower over rolling tea terraces, two stall stamps.

name: Rice Tour
effect: Win 3 rice-based vendors — ba-wan, congee, rice-bowl cake, bamboo-tube rice, turkey rice. Booked from the Chishang (池上) paddies outward: the island runs on rice. Any time.
art_note: Ticket: three rice dishes stamped in a row over a terraced paddy strip.

name: Best Bubble Tea — Origin & Neon
effect: Win a bubble-tea cup — a Taichung teahouse's day cup OR a Dadaocheng riverside neon one — AND a night-market bite. Booked as the run every bubble-tea fan makes, origin to neon, day into night.
art_note: Ticket: a refined teahouse cup and a riverside neon cup stamped together with a gold pearl.

name: Four-Stop Night Run
effect: Win 4 vendors in total. You booked a busy four-stop crossing of the island's night markets — finish any time before the last train.
art_note: Ticket: four stall stamps in a row.

name: The Grand Tour
effect: Win 6 vendors in total. The full album — the grand tour of the island's tables, six stamps deep. Booked to run any time before the last train.
art_note: Ticket: a bulging stamp album.

name: Round-Taiwan · Cycling Route No.1
effect: Win a vendor in ALL 4 regions. You booked the full 環島 lap on Cycling Route No.1 — eat the busload around the whole coast, north to south, mountains to sea.
art_note: Ticket: a bicycle over four regional stamps forming a ring around the island.

name: Big Eater's Feast
effect: Win 5 FOOD vendors in total (drinks don't count). Five stalls cleared across the island — the Big Eater's grand crawl, booked wall to wall, and she's already eyeing a sixth.
art_note: Ticket: a towering stack of five bowls.

name: Top of the Charts
effect: Your won tables cost 9+ ingredients in total. Booked as a tour of the island's priciest, most-checked-in (打卡) headline tables — lean into the big night names.
art_note: Ticket: a towering crowd and raised phones behind a headline stall.

name: True Local
effect: Win 3 vendors in ONE region (any region). You booked the same town three times over — a true local fixture who knows which stall opens when.
art_note: Ticket: three stamps stacked under one region badge.

name: Hualien–Taitung Line
effect: Win 2 East vendors. You booked two stops down the 花東 rift-valley line — Taroko's gorge to the Taitung roselle coast.
art_note: Ticket stamped EAST twice over a stone-slab grill and a gorge road.

name: Surf & Turf
effect: Win 1 South vendor AND 1 North vendor. You booked both ends of the island — Penghu's seafood coast and the capital's grill under Taipei 101.
art_note: Ticket: a Penghu prawn and a pork bun under a Taipei 101 silhouette, stamped together.

name: Taroko–Taipei
effect: Win 1 East vendor AND 1 North vendor. You booked Taroko's mountain rice up to the capital under Taipei 101.
art_note: Ticket: a Taroko-gorge rice ear and a pork bun under Taipei 101, stamped together.

name: Taichung–Kaohsiung
effect: Win 1 Central vendor AND 1 South vendor. You booked the Sun Moon Lake tea belt down to the Kaohsiung harbour, end to end.
art_note: Ticket: a Sun Moon Lake tea leaf and a Kaohsiung-harbour prawn, stamped together.

name: Elbow to the Front
effect: Win 2 CONTESTED vendors (a rival had Followers on them). Two of the island's viral queue-stalls (排隊名店), two rivals left blinking — you elbowed the busload to the front of both.
art_note: Ticket: a roaring queue behind a winning agent.

name: Dawn-to-Dusk Full Day
effect: Win one daytime food, one night-market food, and one drink — one of each. Booked dawn-market to lantern-lit night stall: the whole island day on a plate.
art_note: Ticket: a breakfast bowl, a lantern-lit night stall, and a cup in a triptych.

name: One More Round
effect: Win 3 drink vendors in total. 續攤 — you booked the night-market drink crawl, stall to stall, ending on something sweet. Finish any time.
art_note: Ticket: three dessert-and-drink cups in a row.

name: New-Year Market Haul
effect: Win 5 vendors in total. Booked the Dihua Street New-Year market (年貨大街) — arms full off the dried-goods stalls, red lanterns overhead, five parcels and counting.
art_note: Ticket: a red-lantern New-Year market street, dried-goods stalls, five parcels.

name: Money No Object
effect: Your won tables cost 7+ ingredients in total. 揮金如土 — booked to spare no expense, chasing the island's priciest headline tables and letting the receipts fall where they may.
art_note: Ticket: banknotes fluttering over a banquet.

name: Noodle Run
effect: Win 2 noodle vendors — misua, beef noodle, or Tainan's century-old shrimp bowl. Booked to slurp your way across the island, any time.
art_note: Ticket: two steaming noodle bowls stamped over a lantern-lit lane.

name: Fusion Plate
effect: Win 1 cross-region (→X) dish. One plate where two regions met on the line and got along. Finish any time.
art_note: Ticket: a single dish blending two regions' emblems on one plate.
